frontmatter.name: common-skills
frontmatter.description: Core foundational guidelines and development standards for the MoneyLust project. Includes file length limits (500-600 lines max), check-before-create reuse policy, camelCase naming conventions, btoa/atob prohibition (use js-base64), asking before deleting obsolete files/code, mandatory yarn build verification, Thai function comments (params & returns), and Thai implementation plans.
